question: Who authored the book 'Jinnah: His Successes, Failures and Role in History'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ishtiaq Ahmed.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A new book on the life and times of Pakistan's founder Mohammad Ali Jinnah has been launched The book,** "Jinnah: His Successes, Failures, and Role in History", is written by Swedish political scientist and a noted author of Pakistani descent Ishtiaq Ahmed.**
 
• Born on **December 25th, 1876**, Jinnah served as leader of the All-India Muslim League from 1913 until Pakistan's creation on** Aug 14, 1947**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mr. Khushwant Singh:**

 
 
• He was a** great supporter of diplomatic relations with Israel **at a time when India did not want to displease Arab nations where thousands of Indians found employment.
 
• He visited Israel in the 1970s and was impressed by its progress.
